meaning: These are inventory-backed fallback dispositions for untyped legacy guard output, not evidence that every typed guard path is manual. Unknown guard IDs, missing sites, and malformed typed output remain refusals.

entries.rationale: Parent state is mutable; an untyped legacy parent-state refusal cannot select a safe automatic move.
A dependency edge or completion state needs current graph authority before any unblock remedy.
Untyped close-body refusals or warnings cannot infer checkbox completion or delivery approval.
Untyped Review-body refusals or warnings cannot imply exact-head Test or review evidence.
Untyped Test-body refusals or warnings cannot supply missing AC or verifier proof.
Child and epic ordering depends on live parent state and cannot be inferred from prose.
State-contiguity drift requires reconciliation of board and body authority, not an automatic jump.
Code-completion refusal lacks typed evidence to authorize Test entry or checkbox changes.
Commit attribution must use the exact current HEAD; an untyped refusal cannot stamp it.
Epic child completion is a live graph property and must not be guessed from a legacy message.
A missing or stale verification receipt cannot be synthesized by explanation.
An unresolved discussion token is a human decision boundary with no safe automatic resolution.
Board planning fields require current project evidence; legacy text is not a field update.
Body planning fields require current versioned evidence; untyped output cannot repair them.
Decomposition warnings and refusals require the reviewed WBS and cannot be waived by generic prose.
The deep-dive marker and canonical placement require governed evidence, not an inferred completion.
Epic Plan exit depends on all current child states and cannot be inferred from a partial list.
Exclusive owner and occupancy claims require current board and worktree authority.
Plan approval needs an explicit valid marker or exception; no untyped text can approve it.
Linked plan source and selector conflicts require source repair rather than a guessed plan.
Plan estimate and forecast are governed records; an untyped refusal cannot change their values.
Story intent and approval bindings must match current plan bytes and scope.
Required verification commands need explicit root declarations, not generated execution from free text.
Epic planning admission depends on complete current child state authority.
Refinement cannot overtake a developing parent; current parent state must be checked.
A missing refinement marker requires governed refinement completion evidence.
Refinement snapshot drift requires current board and body comparison, not a stale value.
Stub placeholder content needs human shaping before readiness can be asserted.
A saturated planning WIP budget is a current scheduling constraint, not an auto-override.
Close-gate refusals and warnings combine delivery, approval, and timing authority.
Child disposition must be verified against current graph and issue records before epic close.
Epic close requires all relevant children done or explicitly excluded under current authority.
Review approval requires a current explicit marker; an untyped refusal cannot provide it.
Functional DoD needs exact-head receipts and cannot be satisfied by a legacy message.
Pre-close checkboxes require individual verification and current body evidence.
